name: Game Expression and Representational Cognition: The Designer’s Lived Experience of the World and Its Articulation Through Play
nameZh: 游戏表达与表征认知：设计师对世界的生活体验及其通过游戏的表达
desc: It focuses on how game designers understand and conceptualize games, rather than on how to make games enjoyable.
descZh: 聚焦于设计师如何理解游戏，而非如何让游戏好玩
detail: , emphasizing the active expression of the designer's emotions, philosophy, and personal experience as a creator, rather than mere technical presentation. </n>Representational Thinking / Representational Cognition： Corresponding to 'presentation thinking', it refers to how designers think through representation, using game mechanics, narrative, space, interaction, and other forms to construct and convey their understanding and experience of the world. </n>The Designer’s Lived Experience of the World and Its Articulation Through Play： Explicitly emphasize the
of game designers towards the world, and how this experience is expressed/interpreted through the medium of games.
